verdict.rationale: Extend has no documented region or residency selector. However, the pricing page lists BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments, which would let a customer keep data in infrastructure they control, likely only on higher tiers. The data-handling docs cover configurable retention and zero data retention, but not where data is stored. Missing for 10: an explicit region/residency choice for the hosted service, documentation of available regions (e.g. EU/US), BYOC setup and tier details, and independent corroboration.
